status: ready for run — PP-only redesign (TS mode crashes at graph construction on gemma-4 hybrid SWA in b11819, by design upstream; documented as C-17); v1 archived as invalid for multi-GPU split (v1-invalid-bench/, C-16)
roadmap_block: Block 6: Pipeline vs Tensor parallelism in llama.cpp

runner.binary: llama-completion.exe (one-shot, non-interactive; -no-cnv disables the chat-template conversation path)
runner.why_not_llama_bench: C-16: llama-bench b11819 benchmarks the full model once per device in bench mode; -ts/-sm ineffective there — v1 data valid only as per-card comparison. llama-completion supports true multi-GPU split.
runner.measured_lines: --perf prints separate 'prompt eval time' (pp t/s) and 'eval time / 63 runs' (tg t/s; b11819 one-shot -n N performs N-1 decode steps); one run per cell yields both metrics
runner.batch_equivalence_note: llama-bench b11819 default -b is also 2048 -> CLI numbers comparable with E1/E2 bench data (validated by preflight D equivalence gate)

gpu.prerequisite: CLOSE BOTH LM Studio instances before running (GPU0 instance serves this chat; GPU1 holds ~10.7 GiB). Chat session disconnects during the run.

modes.PP: -dev CUDA0,CUDA1 -sm layer   (split layers and KV across GPUs, pipelined) — the only working split mode in this stack
modes.TS_excluded: -sm tensor -ts 1,1 crashes at graph construction on gemma-4 hybrid SWA: GGML_ASSERT(src_ss[0].axis != SPLIT_AXIS_0), ggml-backend-meta.cpp:547 (per-row ops reject axis-0 splits; by design upstream, present in master); 4 identical reproductions 2026-10-23/24 -> excluded from the grid, documented as C-17

grid.prompt_files: raw/prompts/prompt_{S}.txt — exact token counts verified by llama-tokenize (also prompt_512/1024 for preflights)
grid.cell_command_template: llama-completion.exe -m MODEL -f raw/prompts/prompt_{S}.txt -n 64 -c {S+256} --perf -dev CUDA0,CUDA1 -sm layer -ctk Q -ctv Q -no-cnv --ignore-eos --no-display-prompt

flags_notes.-n 64: one run per cell gives both metrics; decode phase = 63 steps (b11819 one-shot quirk: -n N performs N-1 decode iterations — tg63 semantics, rate comparable to E1/E2); note -n 0 does NOT eval the prompt in llama-completion b11819
flags_notes.--ignore-eos: gemma-4 hits EOS early on synthetic prompts (3/4 tokens in probe) — guarantees full 64 decode steps
flags_notes.-no-cnv: disables conversation mode (auto-enabled because gemma-4 has a chat template); keeps raw prompt path comparable to llama-bench
flags_notes.--no-display-prompt: keeps raw files compact at S=131k/256k

preflights: A: CPU smoke (-dev none, no VRAM) — full pipeline + both perf lines on prompt_512
B: token-count gate for all four prompt files via llama-tokenize -dev none (CPU)
C: PP smoke S=512 f16 both cards, n=64 (-sm layer)

D: equivalence cell — single GPU CUDA1, prompt_1024, f16, n=64; tg must be 40..56 t/s with exactly 63 runs (b11819 one-shot -n N performs N-1 decode steps; E1 baseline ~47-48 @d1k) else abort before grid

metrics.pp_tps: from 'prompt eval time = X ms / N tokens (... tokens per second)' line
metrics.tg_tps: from 'eval time = Y ms / 63 runs (... tokens per second)' line (one-shot -n N performs N-1 decode steps)
metrics.actual_S: '/ N tokens' in the prompt line is the ground-truth processed token count (cited in table)

vram_fit_262k: ~5.7-6 GiB/card for f16 KV in PP mode (weights halved + KV split) << 16 GiB; q8_0 halves KV further
time_estimate: ~40-60 min: prefill dominates (~90-120 s/cell @131k, ~4 min/cell @262k); 4 runs @131k + 2 @262k + preflights A-D
hypotheses_to_test: PP prefill at S>=131k: compute-bound; layers pipelined across the two cards -> up to ~1.8-2x single-GPU (E2) rate minus a small pipeline bubble
tg decode at 131k/262k: batch=1, layer chain serialized across cards -> expect ~0.9-1.0x single-GPU rate (pipeline overhead already visible at S=512: 42.68 vs ~47-48 t/s)
tg decode memory-bound; q8_0 KV halves KV bytes but dequant overhead worsens TPS as S grows on this stack (C-12/C-15) — check whether it pays off at >=131k
TS (-sm tensor) is unusable on gemma-4 in b11819 (graph-construction assert, by design upstream; C-17) — recorded as the negative result of Block 6
launch_protocol: user closes both LM Studio instances, runs run_e3.bat (QWEN_NO_PAUSE=1 optional for unattended), ~40-60 min; then agent processes raw -> table/plot/conclusion + new C-xx
